title: Channel Quota
subtitle: The daily allowance the platform grants to every group and private chat, settled in the quota timezone.

intro.text: This page shows the platform's daily allowance per group / private chat. It is a separate layer from the reply quota on the
intro.after: (that one is a tenant's own self-limit); both must allow a reply.
intro.settingsHint: Timezone, token scope and alert thresholds live under System Settings → Channel Quota.

global.title: Global policy
global.subtitle: The switch here is the master gate: while it is off no channel is limited, and the instance / channel layers can only turn something off while it is on.
global.pauseMessageHint: Leave empty to use the default wording; it is sent in the Bot's voice, at most {{max}} characters.

value.emptyHint: Try another date, state or type; if there is no channel at all, connect one under Instances first.

detail.title: Channel quota detail
detail.sceneHint: This is what the background calls burned; it shares the ledger with the Usage page.
detail.noScene: No calls recorded in this window

policyDialog.inheritHint: Choosing "inherit" leaves this column unset and follows the layer above; the backend only accepts null.
policyDialog.pauseMessageHint: Leave empty to inherit; at most {{max}} characters.
policyDialog.limitInvalid: Enter an integer no smaller than 0, or leave it empty to inherit
policyDialog.pauseTooLong: The pause message must be at most {{max}} characters

bonusDialog.hint: The bonus applies to today only, in the currently effective unit.

recount.all: Recount this day from the ledger
recount.hint: Replies are not recomputed, only tokens. When recounting today, requests that land between the aggregation and the write are overwritten; trust the automatic reconciliation after midnight for today's numbers.
recount.allSuccess: Recounted {{day}} from the ledger: {{channels}} channels processed
recount.channelSuccess: Recounted this channel's tokens from the ledger

tenantDialog.pauseMessageHint: Leave empty to use the platform's wording; at most {{max}} characters.
tenantDialog.ceilingHint: You may only lower it; the server checks it again.
tenantDialog.clearHint: Leave empty to clear your own value and fall back to the platform's limit.
tenantDialog.overCeiling: Must not exceed the platform ceiling {{value}}

instanceSection.title: Channel quota
instanceSection.subtitle: The daily allowance the platform grants to every group / private chat under this instance; the instance layer only sets the columns you change.
instanceSection.myLimitHint: Lower the allowance and set your own pause message on your own instance; it can never exceed the platform ceiling.
